title: Refrigeration Specialist
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Analyze and evaluate critical aspects of the refrigeration industry related to safe work practices and industry standards both in the shop and in the field. Using safe shop practices and the proper use of personal protective equipment, hand tools, meters, gauges and test instruments.
